heading: SP-IT Teaching, Learning, and Evaluation (TLE) Model:
Session 1:
content: This session introduces SP-IT, the concept of academic autonomy, and the philosophy of Outcome-Based Education (OBE) from both student and faculty perspectives. heading: Session 2:
content: This session defines OBE as a student-centered teaching methodology. In an OBE framework, course delivery and assessment are aligned to ensure students meet specific objectives and outcomes, emphasizing the measurement of student performance across various levels. Session 3:
content: This session provides guidance on creating an OBE course file. It explores different assessment methods, attainment targets, and compares outcomes within a closed-loop process for continuous improvement. Session 4:
content: This session is dedicated to establishing target levels for Course Outcomes (COs) and Program Outcomes (POs). It delves into strategies for scaling these outcomes using direct and indirect assessment methods, while also discussing the associated scaling factors. Additionally, the session highlights various publicly available resources from SP-IT designed to enhance teaching and learning for both students and faculty.
